slides.title: Mission Kontrol: repeatable testing
slides.credit: Etienne Palmer-Campbell · NetherRealm · GDC 2025 · PDF p.46
slides.notes: NetherRealm’s Mission Kontrol lets developers request actions without reproducing fighting-game input combinations.
